01 — About

I write the code, not just copy the tutorial

My name is Ziad Mohammed Aref and I work on the front end of the web. I chose to build this portfolio — and the three applications inside it — with vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript on purpose: I wanted to be sure I understand what a framework would normally do for me.

That means a booking wizard that only offers the days a doctor really works, time slots generated from working hours instead of a hard-coded list, a price slider that filters the catalogue as you drag it, and a cart that survives a reload because the state lives in localStorage. No UI library, no helper framework. Each page is interactive — please click around, book a visit, add supplies, change the theme.

I am looking for a training period or internship where I can keep learning on a real team: reading other people's code, reviewing pull requests, and being told when something is wrong instead of quietly guessing.

  • Fundamentals first Semantics, layout, and the box model before any framework.
  • Accessible by default Real buttons, labels, focus states, and keyboard paths through every feature.
  • Small, readable code One clear function beats a clever one-line expression nobody can maintain.

03 — Projects

Three client pages. Click them and use them.

A gym landing page, a clinic booking flow and a medical-supplies storefront — each one opens in your browser with no sign-up and no installation.

What these are: front-end demos. Every booking, cart and order is kept in your own browser's localStorage — there is no server, database or payment gateway behind them, and nothing is sent to anyone. They show how an interface is built, not a live commercial system.

PROJECT 01 LIVE DEMO

IronPulse — gym landing page

A full fitness-club front page: a weekly timetable driven by a data object, a monthly / yearly price switch that recalculates every plan, a BMI calculator with its healthy-weight range, and a trial form that validates an Egyptian mobile number.

  • Tap a day and the class list re-filters
  • Flip Yearly — all three prices drop 20%
  • Enter height and weight to get the BMI marker
Open the gym page Filtering Form validation
PROJECT 02 LIVE DEMO

Nile Care — clinic appointment flow

A clinic page with a specialty filter and name search over the doctor list, then a three-step booking wizard that only offers days the doctor actually works, builds 30-minute slots inside those hours, and blocks the ones already taken.

  • Filter doctors by specialty or search a name
  • Walk the wizard: doctor → date & time → details
  • Reload — the booking stays under My visits
Open the clinic page Multi-step localStorage
PROJECT 03 LIVE DEMO

MedSupply — equipment storefront

An 18-product medical supply shop: instant search, category chips, a max-price slider, stock and discount toggles, four sort modes and a cart drawer that handles quantities, backorder limits, delivery fee and 14% VAT.

  • Drag the price cap and watch the grid update
  • Add items, then change quantities in the cart
  • Reach EGP 1 500 and delivery turns free
